IDT12420.text:

Winds: Easterly 10 to 15 knots turning north to northeasterly below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. The chance of a thunderstorm early this evening.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending southerly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then shifting west to northwesterly below 10 knots in the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the early afternoon.

Sunday 22 November
Winds: Northwest to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers.

Tuesday 24 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots tending southwesterly during the day then shifting north to northwesterly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
IDT12420.synoptic: A low pressure system well to the southwest of Tasmania, extends a trough over the state today. A narrow ridge of high pressure is expected to cross Tasmania during Saturday, ahead of a strong cold front to cross late Sunday, quickly followed by another front early Monday. Another weak ridge is forecast to move over the state during Tuesday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Friday 20 November
Winds: Northeasterly 15 to 20 knots turning northerly in the late evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 metres.
Weather: Cloudy.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: Northerly 15 to 20 knots shifting west to southwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the late morning. Winds reaching up to 30 knots offshore in the late afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to 1 metre during the morning, then increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to 1 to 2 metres by early evening.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 2 metres during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 70% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm inshore in the early afternoon.

Sunday 22 November
Winds: North to northeasterly 15 to 25 knots increasing to 30 knots before tending north to northwesterly 15 to 25 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to 1.5 to 2 metres during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres inshore, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly 1 to 1.5 metres, decreasing to around 1 metre during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 90% chance of showers.

Monday 23 November
Winds: Northwesterly 20 to 30 knots tending westerly during the day.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 1 to 1.5 metres, tending westerly 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre inshore, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres offshore during the morning.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 90% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the evening.
